description: Detach one Host, acquire a new writer generation, and continue solely from canonical conversation rows.
system_prompt: You are running Pulsara's canonical-resume dogfood. Use workspace tools exactly as requested. This tests canonical transcript continuity, not execution replay or long-term memory. Never call memory tools or inspect credentials.

workflow.first_prompt: Read resume_source.txt exactly once, retain its RESUME_TOKEN only in this conversation without calling any memory tool, and write before_resume.txt whose entire contents are that token followed by |before. Do not change the source file.
workflow.resumed_prompt: This is a new Host after canonical reopen. Do not read, search, or call any memory tool. Using only the restored prior conversation, write after_resume.txt whose entire contents are the retained RESUME_TOKEN followed by |after. Use write_file exactly once.
